title: Good: HTTP signature verification design
description: inbox.rs verify_and_fetch_actor (lines 521-644) implements a well-structured HTTP signature verification flow: Date header freshness check (5 min window), mandatory (request-target)/digest/date/host in signed headers, keyId-to-actor anti-spoofing, replay detection with digest-based dedup, cached key with re-fetch on failure for key rotation support, and SSRF validation on outbound fetches. The separation of parse_signature_header, build_signed_string, and verify_rsa_sha256 is clean and testable. The only concern (SEEN_DIGESTS bulk clear) is filed separately.
